text.arabic_uthmani: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: reciprocal cup-sharing, with the drawing image kept cooperative by the explicit cup object
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range around drawing out, pulling, withdrawing, contention, yearning, and related concrete images; local Form VI with the cup selects mutual exchange
words.prose: The verb {{ar:يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ}} ({{tr:yatanāzaʿūna}}) opens the ayah with ongoing reciprocal movement: the cup is the explicit object, so the root image of drawing is heard as people drawing the vessel toward themselves and passing it on. Its stretched recitational shape can also suit the drawn-and-released motion of the exchange. The hidden plural subject keeps the blessed group from the prior scene active, moving from provision in 52:22 into social enjoyment rather than remaining passive recipients. Wider root echoes with dispute (8:46), soul-extraction (79:1), and stripping removal (70:16) are useful as contrast, but local grammar narrows the force to convivial exchange. Structurally, the ayah first shows the shared act and only then defines it by the two exclusions that follow.

topics.headline: reciprocal cup-sharing as bodily motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is not a vague social verb; the cup object turns reciprocal pulling into the physical circulation of a shared vessel.
topics.reason: The explicit direct object and Form VI morphology support reciprocal exchange, while the cup setting blocks a dispute reading.

topics.headline: provided recipients become active agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same blessed group moving from being supplied in 52:22 to acting together in 52:23.
topics.reason: The 3mp ending supplies the subject and discourse continuity makes the prior group available without repeating the noun.

topics.headline: violent extraction field reversed locally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root associated elsewhere with dispute or extraction is reused here as peaceful exchange.
topics.reason: The contrast with 8:46, 79:1, and 70:16 survives as a root-family payoff, but the local direct object and paradise scene keep the selected sense cooperative.

topics.headline: positive action precedes defect exclusions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with lived fellowship before it names what the scene lacks.
topics.reason: The verbal clause comes before the negated nominal construction, making action the first beat and absence the defining follow-up.

words.gloss_range: compact locative pronoun phrase whose referent remains deliberately open between setting and cup relation
words.prose: The first {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) places the exchange before the cup is named. Its feminine suffix can look back to the garden setting or lean forward toward the cup, so the reader should not force a single explicit noun too early. The compact preposition-pronoun shape also prepares the later repetition of {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}), where the same form will move from locating action to locating purity.

topics.headline: garden and cup remain available
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun keeps both the paradise setting and the cup relation live instead of settling the scene prematurely.
topics.reason: Attachment locates the verb, while the suffix antecedent is marked ambiguous between the broader setting and the cup relation.

topics.headline: first half of a repeated containment refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the short locative phrase will return with a changed job, framing both exchange and purity.
topics.reason: The same compact phrase appears again at word 6, first with the action and then with the absence of defect.

topics.headline: location before object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the cup entering an already established location rather than arriving as a bare object.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the direct object, making the setting audible before the vessel is named.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite accusative cup as the handled object of reciprocal exchange, carrying drink and occasion rather than an empty container
words.root_gloss_range: cup/vessel lexeme in the supplied evidence, especially a filled cup in afterlife drinking scenes; no V4 root guardrail was available for this root

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby locative pronoun phrase whose referent remains open between cup and setting

words.prose: {{ar:كَأْسًۭا}} ({{tr:kaʾsan}}) is the accusative object that the reciprocal verb moves, and its indefiniteness makes the vessel repeatable rather than a one-off item. The word does more than name an empty container: the CRITICAL evidence treats it as a filled cup and lets the vessel stand for drink, sharing, and the social occasion whose speech and conscience are then purified. Its internal hamza and tanwīn make the short object land crisply before the negations begin. Because it is feminine, it can help explain why the two {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) pronouns may point toward the cup, though the first pronoun remains ambiguous. In the wider paradise cup series (37:45; 56:18; 76:5; 76:17; 78:34), this ayah specializes the cup not by mixture, overflow, or bodily aftereffect, but by freedom from idle speech and guilt-production.

topics.headline: repeatable handled cup object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cup is grammatically the thing passed around, and its indefiniteness suits recurring abundance.
topics.reason: Accusative case marks the direct object, while singular indefiniteness keeps the instance open and repeatable.

topics.headline: filled cup carries the whole occasion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cup brings along contents and gathering, so the later negations purify a drinking occasion, not just an object.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL lexical evidence supports a filled-vessel reading, and no guardrail evidence contradicts it.

topics.headline: cup can anchor the suffixes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why the cup can remain in play as an antecedent for the two locative pronouns.
topics.reason: The cup is grammatically feminine, but the attachment evidence keeps the pronoun reference ambiguous rather than exclusive.

topics.headline: paradise cup formula specialized by purity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this cup belongs to a marked afterlife-drinking cluster, with this ayah highlighting moral and speech purity.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence profile and CRITICAL rows connect the cup lexeme with afterlife drinking contexts and specific references.

topics.headline: crisp cup word before negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the cup landing as a compact acoustic pivot between flowing action and repeated negation.
topics.reason: The hamza and tanwīn observations add a small but concrete recitational payoff tied to the object position.

words.gloss_range: first negation particle opening the defect-free zone for the speech noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: matching second negation particle in the paired formula

words.prose: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) turns from the positive cup action to the first explicit absence. The grammar can be discussed through a laysa-like nominative reading and through genus-negation force in the variant apparatus, so the safe payoff is categorical exclusion without pretending the local case alone settles every parse. This first negation also anticipates the later {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), opening the paired formula that will deny both communicative and moral defects.

topics.headline: first categorical absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first negation starts an exclusion frame rather than merely saying one instance is missing.
topics.reason: The negation governs the speech noun and pairs with the second negation; case discussions are retained as grammatical alternatives rather than over-specified as one local parse.

topics.headline: shift from action into purity description
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivoting from what they do with the cup to what is absent from the scene.
topics.reason: The first negation begins the nominal purity description immediately after the cup object.

words.gloss_range: negated gerund for purposeless, vain, or disruptive speech, not silence itself
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes what does not count, vain or foul speech, noisy clamor, absorption, deviation, and failure; the local negated gerund selects the speech-defect branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired moral-process noun denied by the second negation

words.prose: {{ar:لَغْوٌۭ}} ({{tr:laghwun}}) names the first defect denied after the cup: not speech as such, but purposeless, vain, or disruptive speech. Its indefinite nominative form under negation broadens the absence, while the accusative variant makes the totalizing genus-negation reading explicit in the apparatus. The root can include active noise-making, as in the disruptive command in 41:26, so the paradise scene is purified from both empty talk and weaponized clamor. The term also joins a repeated paradise formula with the moral noun in 56:25, 78:35, and 88:11, and its tanwīn cadence sets up the matching close with {{ar:تَأْثِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:taʾthīmun}}).

topics.headline: whole class of defective speech denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah excludes the category of defective speech, with local nominative grammar and variant evidence both strengthening the absence.
topics.reason: The local nominative supports a laysa-like reading, while the case variant exposes genus-negation force; both preserve categorical exclusion without collapsing the grammar.

topics.headline: purposeless or noisy speech, not all speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the excluded thing is corrupt speech and clamor, not fellowship or conversation itself.
topics.reason: The accepted branches include non-counting speech, vain or foul speech, and noisy clamor, and the local negation selects that defect field.

topics.headline: paradise soundscape formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this absence belongs to a repeated paradise purity formula, not an isolated comment about one cup.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete paradise references and cooccurrence with the moral noun, especially 56:25.

topics.headline: first absence prepares paired moral close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first denied defect setting both the order and the sound pattern for the second.
topics.reason: The word follows the cup as the first absence beat, then pairs semantically and rhythmically with the final noun.

words.gloss_range: second compact locative pronoun phrase, now locating the absence of defective speech

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the speech-defect noun whose absence this locative phrase predicates
coordinated second negation phrase following the first absence

words.prose: The second {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) does not merely repeat the first; it places the absence of {{ar:لَغْوٌۭ}} ({{tr:laghwun}}) within a domain. Proximity favors the cup, while discourse still allows the garden setting, so the line can imply both a drink that produces no corrupt speech and an environment that contains none. As a repeated compact phrase, it turns location into a purity frame and closes the first absence before {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}) adds the second.

topics.headline: absence located in cup or setting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the absence is located, while the pronoun keeps cup-effect and environment readings alive.
topics.reason: Attachment makes the phrase predicate with the speech noun, and reference evidence preserves ambiguity between cup and setting.

topics.headline: same phrase reframes location as purity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated locative phrase changing function from where exchange happens to where defect is absent.
topics.reason: The recurrence of the same compact form links the opening action to the purity claim.

topics.headline: closure before the coordinated second absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first absence is complete before the conjunction introduces the second.
topics.reason: The locative phrase lands before the coordinating particle, giving the first negated unit its own closure.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that makes the second negation equal to the first while pivoting domains

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: joined conjunction and negator that introduce the second absence

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that keeps the two absences equal. It carries the ayah from the speech defect to the moral defect without making the second a mere explanation of the first. Because it is proclitic in {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}), the connector and negator arrive as one compact coordinated phrase, so the expansion feels smooth rather than like a fresh restart.

topics.headline: second absence coordinated as equal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that moral defect is added beside speech defect as an equal second exclusion.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the final noun as coordinated with the speech noun in the repeated negation construction.

topics.headline: connector fused to second negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second denial arriving as a compact joined phrase rather than a detached restart.
topics.reason: The proclitic conjunction binds directly to the following negator and produces a smooth coordinated expansion.

words.gloss_range: second negation particle extending the absence formula to guilt-producing process

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: moral-process noun governed by the second negation
preceding conjunction that coordinates the second negation

words.prose: The second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) repeats the negation force for {{ar:تَأْثِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:taʾthīmun}}). Bound after {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}), it makes the moral absence coordinate with the speech absence, not subordinate to it. It also opens the ayah final landing, so the last word is heard under explicit negation rather than as a loose ethical note.

topics.headline: second negation scopes over moral process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the negation frame extending from defective speech to the whole category of guilt-producing process.
topics.reason: The second negator governs the final noun and inherits the parallel construction established by the first negation.

topics.headline: double negation prepares final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated negator bracketing the second half of the ayah and preparing the final moral term.
topics.reason: The second negator opens the closing segment and mirrors the first negator across the purity phrase.

words.gloss_range: negated Form II verbal noun for causing, assigning, or producing guilt, not merely the state of sin
words.root_gloss_range: root range around sin and culpability; local Form II verbal noun selects the causative or attributive process, with no V4 root guardrail available

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: paired speech-defect noun in the same double-negation formula

words.prose: {{ar:تَأْثِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:taʾthīmun}}) closes the ayah by denying not just guilt as a state, but the process that causes, assigns, or produces guilt. Its Form II verbal-noun shape makes the mechanism diffuse: no accuser or agent needs to be named because the whole liability-producing chain is absent. The nominative, indefinite cadence and the hamza onset make the final term formally sharp as it matches {{ar:لَغْوٌۭ}} ({{tr:laghwun}}), while the accusative variant makes the total category exclusion overt in recitation evidence. The pairing with {{ar:لَغْوٌۭ}} ({{tr:laghwun}}) also echoes the paradise formula in 56:25, and the contrast with wine described through the basic sin noun in 2:219 sharpens the point: this cup is framed by the absence of harm-production. As the final word, {{ar:تَأْثِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:taʾthīmun}}) gives the scene its moral landing.

topics.headline: Form II process of guilt-production denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah negates the mechanism that could cause or assign guilt, not only the resulting guilty state.
topics.reason: The local word is a Form II verbal noun, and the CRITICAL rows consistently distinguish process from the basic sin-state noun.

topics.headline: parallel nominative cadence plus variant force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final noun formally matching the earlier speech noun while variant evidence exposes the strength of total negation.
topics.reason: The supplied reading is nominative and parallel to the speech noun; the accusative variant is retained as apparatus for genus-negation force.

topics.headline: speech and conscience purified together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun completes a paired formula covering communicative and moral purity together.
topics.reason: The final noun is coordinated with the speech noun, shares the repeated negation frame, and is linked by CRITICAL rows to the 56:25 pairing.

topics.headline: earthly wine harm inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a contrast between earthly wine harm in 2:219 and the paradise cup where guilt-production is absent.
topics.reason: The root contrast with 2:219 survives as an inter-ayah payoff, but the local form is the causative process noun, not the same basic noun.

topics.headline: closing word gives moral landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending on the absence of guilt-production as its final semantic and acoustic takeaway.
topics.reason: The final position makes the moral absence the closing beat of the act-absence-absence architecture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reciprocal form in يتنازعون governs كأسا, while two nominal negations qualify the shared scene.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mutual pulling is not merely conflict: its own branch explicitly includes exchanging a cup. Vessel and contents move as one social unit, while false or foul speech and the loading of guilt are excluded from the transfer.

activation_trace.role: The mutual-pulling branch literally includes cup exchange and makes reciprocity the social engine.
The cup-with-contents image makes vessel and drink one circulating unit.
The false-or-foul-speech image identifies the verbal corruption absent from the exchange.
The image of loading or charging sin makes the second negation remove blame-transfer between participants.

changed_reading.before: They contend over a cup, with bad side effects denied.
changed_reading.after: They actively pass and offer the cup among themselves; reciprocity remains lively while corrupt speech and interpersonal blame fail to travel with it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ن ز ع verb can carry inward attraction toward a desired object, here the cup.
baseline_models.mechanism: The scene can be appetitive rather than adversarial. Souls incline toward the drink, but desire neither ends in disappointment nor slows anyone from good; pleasure reaches its object without frustration or moral drag.

activation_trace.role: The yearning-toward-a-desired-object image turns the reciprocal verb into shared appetite.
The contained drink gives that attraction a concrete and reachable object.
The failure or disappointment image lets the first negation remove frustrated desire.
The lagging-from-good image lets the second negation remove the delay or drag usually attached to appetite.

changed_reading.before: The cup is an object fought over.
changed_reading.after: The cup draws all participants toward desired enjoyment, yet access neither fails nor diverts them from good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins extraction, a cup-composite, what is discarded from account, and what is charged onto a person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Read materially and administratively, the drink is drawn out and transferred with no remainder written off and no liability loaded onto its recipient. The exchange leaves neither waste nor moral residue.

activation_trace.role: The pulling-out image supplies extraction of the drink from its place and initiates transfer.
The vessel-and-content composite supplies the bounded material being transferred.
The discarded-or-uncounted image makes its negation remove waste and write-off.
The loading-a-charge image makes its negation remove liability from the recipient.

changed_reading.before: The negatives promise only decent behavior while drinking.
changed_reading.after: The whole transfer is residue-free: nothing is discarded from value and no moral charge adheres to whoever receives the cup.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A ن ز ع branch names the pleasant finish of a drink as it is drawn away from the mouth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb may glance not only at passing the cup but at each drink's endpoint. Its finish is pleasant: no clamor emerges after drinking, and even the uncertain lexical association of ithm with wine is explicitly canceled.

activation_trace.role: The good-finish-of-a-drink image directly supplies a pleasant endpoint or aftertaste.
The cup and its drink make the finish branch locally concrete rather than free-floating.
The mixed clamor image identifies a noisy aftereffect that does not follow the drink.
The reported naming of wine as ithm lets the negation touch the drink-category itself, though the branch remains lexically uncertain.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only the cup's movement among drinkers.
changed_reading.after: It also describes the drink's clean finish: pleasant at withdrawal from the mouth and barren of noisy or morally toxic aftermath.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same reciprocal branch genuinely includes contention as well as cup exchange, so the agonistic force need not be erased.
baseline_models.mechanism: A playful tug, eager rivalry, or verbal contest may remain. What disappears is not intensity but its conversion into false speech or accusatory guilt; the verse imagines competition that does not injure fellowship.

activation_trace.role: The reciprocal-contention image preserves real social tension rather than reducing the verb to neutral delivery.
The shared drink bounds the contest around a pleasurable common object.
The foul-speech image marks the harmful turn that the contest never takes.
The blame-loading image marks the social injury that reciprocal intensity does not produce.

changed_reading.before: Paradisal harmony requires all rivalry to vanish.
changed_reading.after: Eager contest can survive as harmless convivial play because neither verbal corruption nor blame is generated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier punitive scene uses a severe one-way push into fire; the focus uses a reciprocal pull around a cup. That directional reversal recasts the cup scene as restored agency: no party is mere object, and each both gives and receives.

activation_trace.role: The severe-pushing image supplies unilateral coercion as the scene's negative spatial foil.
The mutual-pulling image reverses that geometry into distributed agency around the cup.
The absent blame-load confirms that reciprocal handling does not recreate coercive injury.

structural_cues: 52:13 gives a passive plural a forced destination; 52:23 gives an active reciprocal plural a shared object.
Fire and cup occupy parallel destination-object positions but reverse agency and outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one-way severe pushing and later mutual pulling; I infer a deliberate reversal of agency. A live alternative is simple contrast between destinies without a shared motion schema.

changed_reading.before: The cup exchange is merely a pleasant action.
changed_reading.after: The cup exchange is an anti-coercive social form in which motion and agency are reciprocal rather than imposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to drink with ease and no ill effect activates the otherwise surprising pleasant-finish branch of ن ز ع. The two negations become the anatomy of hani'an: no noisy aftermath and no moral toxicity.

activation_trace.role: The literal taking of liquid confirms that the surrounding pleasure includes actual drinking.
The ease-without-hardship-or-ill-effect image supplies the drink's governing quality.
The pleasant-finish image localizes that ease at the drink's withdrawal and aftermath.
The negated clamor image specifies one ill effect excluded from the finish.

structural_cues: 52:19 explicitly commands drinking hani'an four ayat before the cup scene.
The focus's paired negations follow the drinking object rather than standing as a general paradise slogan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pleasant, harmless drinking and a branch for a drink's good finish; I infer that the latter specifies the former. Alternatively hani'an may characterize consumption globally, with no special aftertaste emphasis.

changed_reading.before: The good-finish branch is a vivid but isolated lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The prior promise of harmless, easy drinking makes the cup's clean finish a contextually supported reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairing one being to another and making later descendants catch up activate the ن ز ع image of being drawn back to origin or stock. Passing the cup can therefore enact recovered belonging: reunited relations repeatedly draw the shared vessel toward one another.

activation_trace.role: The making-of-one-thing-as-counterpart-to-another image supplies deliberate social pairing.
The later-one-catching-up-to-what-is-ahead image supplies reunion across separation or sequence.
The being-drawn-back-to-origin-or-stock image anchors the reunion mechanism in the focus verb.
The common vessel and contents become the tangible token passed through the restored relation.

structural_cues: Pairing and descendant-attachment in 52:20-21 immediately precede provisioning and cup exchange.
The reciprocal plural in 52:23 allows every reunited party to draw and be drawn into the act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, catching-up, and a focus branch for return to stock; I infer that cup exchange ritualizes reunion. The live alternative is that the stock image is merely etymic and the cup remains generic hospitality.

changed_reading.before: The drinkers are an already assembled anonymous group.
changed_reading.after: Their cup-passing can perform kinship restored after separation, repeatedly materializing their renewed attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context keeps personal deeds collateralized, yet also joins descendants without deduction, grants release without compensation, and rejects a burdensome liability. Against that ledger, the cup circulates as gift: nothing is written off as worthless, but no charge is attached to its recipient.

activation_trace.role: The document held against a right supplies the surrounding logic of individual collateral and accountability.
The release-without-compensation image supplies a contrasting economy of gratuitous benefit.
The binding financial liability image makes burdensome quid pro quo an explicit negative foil.
The discarded-or-uncounted image keeps the gift from becoming valueless or lost from account.
The absent loading of a charge prevents the received pleasure from becoming liability.

structural_cues: 52:21 juxtaposes personal pledge with attachment of descendants and no decrement of work.
52:27 names unbought release, while 52:40 frames burdensome liability as a rejected explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collateral, non-deduction, gratuitous release, and liability; I assign the cup to the gift side of that contrast. A live alternative is perfect settlement within a ledger rather than exemption from exchange-accounting.

changed_reading.before: No laghw and no ta'thim mean a perfectly clean transaction.
changed_reading.after: The cup is valuable yet non-debt-producing: it circulates as gratuitous abundance without erasing each person's separate moral account.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is extended as connected increase precisely toward what they desire. That pairing activates ن ز ع as yearning while removing scarcity from its reciprocal form: many can reach eagerly for the cup without anyone's desire failing another's.

activation_trace.role: The connected increase that supplies another with aid or material establishes replenishing abundance.
The soul's inclination toward what it desires directly echoes the appetitive focus branch.
The yearning image turns reciprocal reaching into convergent desire rather than hostile seizure.
The negated failure image ensures that shared appetite does not end in disappointed access.

structural_cues: 52:22 places extended provision and desire immediately before the cup.
The object changes from desired food in 52:22 to drink in 52:23 while the appetitive sequence continues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies connected increase and desire; I infer that abundance prevents reciprocal desire from becoming scarcity-conflict. Alternatively the extension may denote variety rather than inexhaustibility.

changed_reading.before: Several drinkers reach for one scarce-looking cup.
changed_reading.after: Their simultaneous attraction indexes abundance: provision keeps extending, so eager reciprocity cannot deprive another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Circling attendants and a group turning toward one another place the cup inside a loop rather than a two-person handoff. Reciprocal drawing distributes service across a face-to-face assembly, while the negations prevent noise and blame from accumulating as the vessel moves.

activation_trace.role: The circling-around image supplies the larger service loop surrounding the cup exchange.
The group-facing-one-another image supplies a reciprocal social topology rather than a queue.
The mutual-pulling and cup-exchange image makes each participant a node in that circulation.
The vessel-with-contents image supplies the unit that travels around the loop.

structural_cues: 52:24 follows the focus with attendants circling around the same seated company.
52:25 then turns members of the company toward one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies circular service and mutual facing; I infer a distributed circulation in which the cup links the assembly. Alternatively attendants alone circulate while the drinkers exchange locally.

changed_reading.before: The cup passes across a single reciprocal pair.
changed_reading.after: The cup traces a social circuit through a mutually facing assembly, repeatedly renewing relation as it moves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the cup, mutual questioning opens into articulated recollection. Therefore no laghw cannot mean no speech: it means speech remains meaningful rather than false or noisy, and recollection proceeds without participants loading guilt onto one another.

activation_trace.role: The mutual-questioning image supplies explicitly reciprocal conversation after the cup scene.
The uttered-speech image supplies the answer and proves that audible language continues.
The false-or-foul-speech image narrows the negation from all talk to corrupted talk.
The absent blame-loading image allows shared memory without accusation among speakers.

structural_cues: 52:25-28 forms a question-answer-prayer sequence immediately after 52:23.
The focus negates qualities within the cup scene, not the capacity for speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies actual post-cup dialogue; I infer that it exemplifies the kind of speech left after laghw and blame are removed. Alternatively the later conversation may be temporally separate from drinking.

changed_reading.before: No laghw suggests quiet decorum or an absence of conversation.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is verbally active: questions and testimony circulate, but words neither collapse into false noise nor weaponize remembered fear as blame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later discourse repeatedly attributes invented speech and is challenged to produce a comparable utterance truthfully. This sharpens the focus pair: laghw is counterfeit saying, while ta'thim is the guilt such attribution attempts to fasten onto another.

activation_trace.role: The saying-or-attributing-what-never-was image supplies counterfeit attribution as the polemical speech failure.
The speech-renewed-as-report image supplies the demanded positive discourse object.
The truth-of-speech image supplies the criterion that separates meaningful report from fabrication.
The false-speech image anchors counterfeit discourse in the focus negation.
The charging-sin image explains fabricated attribution as an attempt to load culpability onto its target.

structural_cues: 52:29-44 is densely organized around labels, claims, challenges, evidence, and misdescription.
52:33-34 places fabricated attribution directly against truthful production of discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution and a truth-conditioned speech challenge; I infer that these expose the absent mechanism named in 52:23. Alternatively the later polemic concerns revelation only and need not define banquet speech.

changed_reading.before: Laghw is merely idle or indecent table talk, and ta'thim merely intoxication's moral consequence.
changed_reading.after: The pair also excludes a whole accusatory speech mechanism: invent a saying, attribute it to another, then make that person bear its guilt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it scales a cosmic water-image down into tableware. It remains anchored in the focus cup and the hand-drawn-water branch of ن ز ع, with the earlier filled sea supplying a material analogue; render only as a scale-changing image, not as a claim that the cup literally is the sea.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cup is a bounded vessel-and-content unit, and the focus verb has a branch for water drawn directly by hand.

activation_trace.role: The vast abundant-water image supplies the scene's maximal liquid reservoir.
The being-filled-with-water image makes that reservoir materially replete.
The hand-drawn-water image scales abundance into an intimate act of direct drawing.
The vessel-with-contents image gives the vast liquid a finite shareable boundary.

changed_reading.before: The cup is ordinary banquet equipment.
changed_reading.after: The cup can image cosmic abundance made graspable: a hand-drawn, bounded share of the earlier replete expanse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a bowstring is form-distant from drinking. It remains anchored in a live focus branch and gains spatial support from the aligned couches; render as a kinesthetic analogy for held and released social tension, never as a lexical replacement for cup exchange.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reciprocal verb retains the ن ز ع branch of drawing a bowstring, while the object remains the cup.

activation_trace.role: The alignment-on-a-level-line image supplies ordered endpoints across the seated company.
The drawn-bowstring image supplies tension held between opposed pulls and released into motion.
The cup-with-drink image keeps that tension attached to convivial handling rather than weaponry.
The absent guilt-load prevents released tension from landing as injury or accusation.

changed_reading.after: Across the aligned gathering, cup exchange repeatedly draws and releases relational tension without turning that stored energy into harm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines well-drawing, replenishing water, and circular motion into a hydraulic model. It remains anchored in the cup and an explicit water-drawing focus branch, with immediate extension and circling cues; render as a material analogy for inexhaustible circulation, not hidden plumbing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a hand-drawing branch of ن ز ع to a vessel that includes its liquid contents.

activation_trace.role: The water-replenished-by-other-water image supplies continued inflow to the provision.
The circling image bends linear supply into a recurring service loop.
The hand-drawn-water image supplies extraction at each act of drinking.
The vessel-and-liquid composite is the moving chamber of the inferred loop.
The negated failure image marks the circuit as nonstalling rather than exhaustible.

changed_reading.before: A finite cup is repeatedly passed.
changed_reading.after: Each drawing participates in a replenished circuit: the cup moves, empties, refills, and never reaches failure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends laghw from bad talk into perceptual classification. It remains anchored in the focus branch for deviation from correctness and is activated by the later sight-to-conjectural-label sequence; render as an epistemic extension of purified speech, not as the primary sense of laghw.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated ل غ و has a branch for turning away from correctness, adjacent to the negation of loading guilt.

activation_trace.role: The seeing-by-eye-and-insight image supplies the perceptual input that can be handled rightly or wrongly.
The detached-piece image supplies what is actually presented to sight.
The saying-that-runs-as-conjecture image supplies the mistaken verbal classification of what is seen.
The deviation-from-correctness image lets the focus negate that slide from perception into a false label.
The absent guilt-load prevents a mistaken label from becoming an accusation attached to another.

changed_reading.before: No laghw means no idle or obscene speech.
changed_reading.after: Speech in the cup scene may also be epistemically clean: perception is not bent into a convenient false name, then converted into blame.

strongest_changes: The reciprocal verb remains bifocal: it can be idiomatic cup-passing or real playful contention detoxified by the two negations.
The push-to-pull reversal makes the scene a restoration of reciprocal agency rather than pleasure alone.
Extended desired provision, social reunion, circular service, and post-cup dialogue turn the cup into an abundant relational circuit.
Collateral, gratuitous release, and burdensome liability revise the negatives into a gift economy: value remains, debt does not attach.
The later fabrication challenge changes no-laghw from mere table decorum into protection against counterfeit attribution and blame-loading.
summary.what_was_special: One focus inventory simultaneously supplied literal cup exchange, contention, yearning, return to stock, hand-drawn water, bow tension, and a pleasant drink-finish. The surrounding sequence activated several of these into causal models without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether B006 neutralizes contention into idiomatic passing or preserves a real playful contest remains genuinely open.
The pleasant-finish reading is unusually exact but may be a lexical echo rather than the verb's operative sense here.
The accounting cues can support either release from transactional liability or perfectly settled accounting.
The sea, bowstring, hydraulic, and perceptual models are anchored analogies and should not be promoted to unqualified lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Pulling rehabilitated as circulation.** `ن ز ع` B001 is pulling from place; the reciprocal form turns extraction into exchange. `ل غ و` B001 is what does not count and B002 vain speech; double negation removes waste and blame. I supply reciprocal pulling under abundance -> convivial passing, not rivalry.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The questioning in 52:25 showed what replaces vain speech: consequential recollection among mutually facing companions.

error_profile.preserves: Güçlü istek ile belirli bir hedefe yönelme bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan veya hayvanın ayrıldığı yurda geri dönme isteğinin anlatıldığı bağlamlarda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Alışık olunan yere duyulan güçlü özlemi korur.
error_profile.loses: Başka istek nesnelerini ve hayvanın eşleşme yönelimini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal herhangi bir istek nesnesine yönelmeyi ve hayvanın eşleşme isteğini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle daha önce tanınan veya ayrılınan yere, yavruya ya da nesneye duyulan özlemi öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin veya hayvanın özlenen bir hedefe içten yönelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın tanıdık ve ayrılmış hedef sınırı daha dardır; odak dal genel istek ve eşleşme yönelimine de uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: İstek, özlem ve hayvan yönelimi adayları değerlendirildi; alışılmış olana özlem dalı en yakın kapsam karşılaştırmasını sağlar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه منازعة النفس إلى الشيء والنزوع إليه والاشتياق والحنين إلى الأهل والوطن والمرعى وطلب الفحل
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الشبه بالأب أو العرق إلا إذا كان نزوعا إلى أصل النسب لا شوقا
branches.source_phrase_ar: نازعت النفس إلى الأمر نزاعا ونزعت إليه إذا اشتهته (maqayis)؛ نزع فلان إلى أهله أي اشتاق (sihah)؛ هو ينزع إليه نزاعا (tahdhib)؛ النزوع الاشتياق الشديد (mufradat)؛ أنزع القوم نزعت إبلهم إلى أوطانها (mufradat)؛ غنم نزع إذا حنت فاشتهت الفحل (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız kökene benzeme yönelimini değil, başka topluluğa geçirilmiş atları, topluluğu dışında evlenen kadınları ve kendi halkı dışında bulunan yabancıyı da sayar. Bu nedenle tek yönlü bir kökene çekilme tanımı yerine kökenle bağ veya kendi topluluğundan ayrılmışlık çevresinde kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Soya benzerlik ile topluluk dışına çıkarılmış veya orada yaşayan kişi ve hayvan adları aynı şey değildir; ayrı yüzler olarak korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıba bağlı soy benzerliği ile adlaşmış at, kadın ve yabancı kullanımları birbirine karıştırılmadan aynı kaynak kümesinde gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığın kökeniyle ilişkisinin görünür olması ya da kendi topluluğundan ayrılıp başka bir topluluk içinde bulunması çevresindeki kullanımlar kümesidir. At adında, soya benzerlik ile başka bir topluluktan alınmış olma arasında kaynakların aktardığı iki açıklama vardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişinin görünüşü atasına veya soy çizgisine bağlanır.
Kadın veya yabancı, kendi topluluğu dışında bulunması bakımından adlandırılır.
Atlar için ad, soya çekmeyi ya da başka bir topluluktan alınıp getirilmiş olmayı gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık, soy benzerliğini ve kişinin kendi topluluğu dışında bulunmasını birlikte verir; at adının ise soya benzerlik veya başka ellerden alınmışlık biçiminde iki açıklaması aktarılır.

concept_gloss.text: köken bağı veya topluluk dışına çıkmışlık
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın tek bir eylem olmadığını, soy benzerliği ile topluluk dışındaki konumu ayrı yüzler olarak içerdiğini gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Köken benzerliği, yabancılık ve başka topluluğa geçme yüzlerini ayrı tutar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin görünüş veya özellik bakımından atasına benzediği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Soy çizgisinden gelen benzerlik yüzünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Topluluk dışındaki kadın ve yabancı adlarını, ayrıca at adındaki ikinci açıklamayı dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: soyuna çeken ya da başka bir topluluktan alınmış atlar

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal topluluk dışına çıkmış kadın ve yabancıyı, ayrıca at adındaki iki açıklamayı da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız bir kişinin atasına benzemesi ve benzerliğin ona yönelmesiyle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişinin görünüş veya özellik bakımından atasına çekmesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Soy benzerliği yüzünde yakınlık yüksektir, fakat odak dalın topluluk dışındaki konuma dayanan adları komşu dalda yoktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Soy, köken ve yabancılık adayları değerlendirildi; atasına benzemek dalı yalnız ilk yüzle en yakın karşılaştırmayı verir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نزع الشبه إلى الأب أو العرق والنزائع من الخيل والنساء والغريب النزيع
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد حنين الحيوان إلى الوطن ولا مجرد الخصومة
branches.source_phrase_ar: نزع إلى أبيه في الشبه (maqayis)؛ النزائع من الخيل التي نزعت إلى أعراق (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ النزائع من النساء اللواتي يزوجن في غير عشائرهن (maqayis;sihah)؛ كل غريب نزيع (maqayis)؛ إنما هو عرق نزعه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karşılıklı çekmeyi çekirdek yapar ve bunu tartışma ile çekişmeye aktarır; kadehi birbirine uzatma ve el sıkışma da aynı karşılıklılığın özel yapılarıdır. Geçici çerçevedeki okuma çekişmesi ise kaynak ifadesinde bulunmadığından tanıma alınmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kurucu özellik iki tarafın karşılıklı katılımıdır; tek taraflı olarak bir şeyi yerinden çekmek bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı çekişme yalın biçimlerde korunur; kadeh uzatma ve el sıkışma yalnız kendi kalıplarına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın bir şeyi karşılıklı çekmesi veya birbirine karşı üstünlük aramasıdır; bu şema sözlü tartışma ve çekişme için kullanılır. Belirli yapılarda kadehi karşılıklı uzatma ya da el sıkışma gibi karşılıklı eylemleri de anlatır.

facets.statement: İki taraf aynı nesne veya mesele üzerinde karşılıklı çekme ve karşı koyma ilişkisine girer.
Karşılıklı çekme şeması, sözlü tartışma ve kanıtlarla çekişme alanına aktarılır.
Kadehi birbirine uzatma ve el sıkışma, karşılıklı el hareketine bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar karşılıklı çekmeyi ortak temel sayar; tartışma ve kanıt çekişmesini bu temelin soyut kullanımı, kadeh uzatma ile el sıkışmayı ise yapılaşmış özel kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel karşılıklı çekme ile tartışmadaki karşı koyma çekirdeğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İki tarafın aynı alan üzerinde birbirine karşı güç uygulamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki tarafın söz ve kanıtlarla birbirine karşı çıktığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı sözlü karşı koyma ve üstünlük arama yüzünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Fiziksel çekmeyi, kadeh uzatmayı ve el sıkışmayı kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal fiziksel karşılıklı çekmeyi ve kadeh uzatma ile el sıkışma yapılarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sözün karşılıklı çevrilmesi, sözlü üstünlük kurma ve tartışmada yenme üzerinde yoğunlaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da tarafların söz ve kanıtlarla birbirine karşı çıktığı tartışma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın fiziksel karşılıklılık çekirdeği daha geniştir; komşu dalın kurucu alanı sözlü tartışmadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Çekişme ve tartışma adayları karşılaştırıldı; sözlü çekişme dalı çekirdekteki fiziksel karşılıklılığı en iyi görünür kılar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المنازعة والتنازع والمخاصمة والمجادلة ومجاذبة الحجج ومعاطاة الكأس ومنازعة القراءة والمصافحة
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه نزع الشيء من مقره بلا مشاركة من طرف آخر
branches.source_phrase_ar: نازعته منازعة ونزاعا إذا جاذبته في الخصومة (sihah)؛ التنازع التخاصم (sihah)؛ المنازعة في الخصومة مجاذبة الحجج (tahdhib)؛ منازعة الكأس معاطاتها (tahdhib)؛ نازعني فلان بنانه أي صافحني (tahdhib)؛ التنازع والمنازعة المجاذبة ويعبر بهما عن المخاصمة والمجادلة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, saçın alnın iki yanından çekilmesini, bu niteliği taşıyan kişiyi ve iki çekilme bölgesini aynı bedensel görünüm çevresinde açıkça birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Alan özellikle alnın iki yanındaki saç çizgisidir; kaynaklar bu biçimin kadın için aynı türetmeyle söylenmediğini de belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız yalın biçimlerle adlandırılan saç çizgisi görünümünü kapsar ve başka saç giderme yapılarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Saç çizgisinin alnın iki yanında geriye çekilmiş olması ve bu çekilmenin oluşturduğu iki bölgedir.

facets.statement: Saç, alnın iki yanından geriye çekilmiş görünür.
İki yandaki çekilmiş saç çizgisi bölgeleri ayrı bir ikil adla gösterilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar görünümü alnın iki yanındaki saçın gerilemesiyle tanımlar, ilgili iki bölgeyi adlandırır ve kadın için aynı biçimin kullanılmadığı sınırını aktarır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Alnın iki yanındaki özgül saç çekilmesini ve oluşan iki bölgeyi birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Saçın iki yanda gerilemesi ile bölgesel sınırı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir erkeğin saç çizgisindeki iki yanlı gerilemeyi betimleyen cümlede doğal kullanımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Alnın iki yanındaki saç gerilemesini açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: alnın iki yanındaki açılmış saç çizgisi bölgeleri

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal saçın özellikle alnın iki yanından gerilemesini ve iki çekilme bölgesini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal saçın başın önünden gitmesini ve daha genel ön bölge açıklığını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da başın ön kısmında saçın bulunmaması veya gerilemesi görünümünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iki yanlı ve bölgesel bir saç çizgisi biçimidir; komşu dal daha geniş ön bölge açıklığıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Saç, alın ve baş önü adayları değerlendirildi; genel ön saç açıklığı dalı en yakın fakat daha geniş sınırı sunar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأنزع والنزعتان وموضع انحسار الشعر عن جانبي الجبهة
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يقال للمرأة نزعاء في هذه المادة بل زعراء بحسب المصادر
branches.source_phrase_ar: النزعة الموضع من رأس الأنزع (maqayis)؛ رجل أنزع بين النزع (sihah)؛ الأنزع الذي انحسر الشعر عن جانبي جبهته (tahdhib)؛ رجل أنزع زال عنه شعر رأسه (mufradat)؛ لا يقال امرأة نزعاء ولكن زعراء (maqayis;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kuyunun sığlığını suyun elle ya da ipi bağlı bir kovayı elle çekerek çıkarılabilmesi koşuluna bağlar; kuyu niteliği ile su çekme eylemi aynı yapı içinde desteklenir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam her kuyuya veya her su çıkarma yöntemine değil, el erişimine uygun sığ kuyu ve elle çekme düzenine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız sığ kuyu ve elle su çekme kalıplarına bağlıdır; genel çıkarma ya da genel kuyu anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Suyu el gücüyle çekilebilecek kadar sığ olan kuyu veya böyle bir kuyudan, ipi bağlı kovayı elle çekerek su çıkarma durumudur.

facets.statement: Kuyu, suyun el gücüyle doğrudan çekilebildiği kadar sığdır.
Su, ipi kovaya bağlı olan kovanın elle çekilmesiyle çıkarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar sığ kuyu niteliğini ve suyun elle, özellikle ipi bağlı bir kovanın elle çekilmesini aynı sınırlı kullanımda birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kuyunun sığlığını ve suyun el gücüyle çekilebilmesini birlikte veren tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sığ kuyu, elle erişim ve su çekme koşullarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuyudan su çıkarma eyleminin anlatıldığı cümlede, ipin doğrudan elle çekildiğini belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: Kovayı el gücüyle çekerek su çıkarma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kuyunun sığ olma niteliğini tek başına adlandırmaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kovayı elle çekerek kuyudan su almak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuyunun sığ olması ve suyun ipi doğrudan elle çekilen kovayla alınması koşullarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kovayı araç olarak ve kuyuda aşağı gönderilip geri çekilmesi işlemini derinlik sınırı olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kuyu, kova ve suyu yukarı çekme senaryosu bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sığ kuyu ve doğrudan el gücüyle sınırlıdır; komşu dalın konusu ise kovanın kendisi ve genel kuyu işlemidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kuyu, kova ve su çıkarma adayları değerlendirildi; kova dalı aynı senaryoda araç ile kuyu niteliğini en iyi ayırır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البئر النزوع أو النزيع القريبة القعر والاستقاء باليد أو بدلو معلق بها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه كل استخراج عام ولا كل بئر عميقة
branches.source_phrase_ar: بئر نزوع قريبة القعر ينزع منها باليد (maqayis)؛ بئر نزوع ونزيع أي قريبة القعر ينزع منها باليد (sihah)؛ نزع بيده إذا استقى بدلو علق فيها الرشاء (tahdhib)؛ بئر نزوع قريبة القعر ينزع منها باليد (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı adı kişinin işlerinde dönüp dayandığı görüş ve düzenleme yolu ile görüş kararlılığı ve amaç gücü için kullanır; yakınlık niteliği de amacın erişim mesafesini bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal somut araç, ok veya içeceğin bitiş tadı değildir; zihinsel yöneliş, görüş ve amaç gücüyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Adlaşmış zihinsel anlam ile yakınlık bildiren kalıp ayrı tutulur; somut eş adlı kullanımlar bu tanıma alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin işlerinde dayandığı görüş ve düzenleme yönü ile o görüşü yürütmesini sağlayan karar ve amaç gücüdür; belirli bir yapıda amacın yakınlığı da anlatılır.

facets.statement: Kişi işlerinde bir görüşe ve düzenleme yoluna dönüp dayanır.
Ad, görüşte kararlılık ve amacı gerçekleştirme gücünü de bildirir.
Yakınlık bildiren yapıda amacın veya ulaşılacak noktanın yakın olması anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar görüş, düzenleme, kararlılık ve amaç gücünü aynı zihinsel alanda toplar; yakınlık yapısını da amacın yakın oluşuna bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin dayandığı düşünceyi, düzenleme yolunu ve onu izleme kararlılığını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Görüş, düzenleme, karar ve amaç gücü bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin düşüncesindeki sağlamlık ve o düşünceyi uygulama gücü öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görüşte kararlılık ve amaç gücünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Düzenleme yolu ile amacın yakınlığı kullanımını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: görüş, düzenleme yolu ve amaç gücü

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin dayandığı görüşü, düzenleme yolunu ve amacın yakınlığını birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal içte oluşan istek ve kararı, ayrıca amacın yüksek ya da düşük oluşunu daha genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin bir hedefe yönelmesini ve onu izleme gücünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görüş ve düzenleme için başvurulan zihinsel dayanağı öne çıkarır; komşu dal daha genel istek ve karar alanıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Görüş, amaç, karar ve düzenleme adayları karşılaştırıldı; amaç ve kararlılık dalı en yakın fakat daha genel alanı gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه منزعة الرجل رأيه وتدبيره وقوة عزم الرأي والهمة وقرب المنزعة
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه آلة مشتار العسل ولا السهم ولا حسن ختام الشراب
branches.source_phrase_ar: فلان قريب المنزعة أي قريب الهمة (maqayis;sihah)؛ منزعة الرجل رأيه (maqayis)؛ المنزعة ما يرجع إليه الرجل من أمره ورأيه وتدبيره (sihah)؛ المنزعة قوة عزم الرأي والهمة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bal toplama aracı, ok, su çekenin üzerinde durduğu kaya ve içe doğru eğri yay gibi tek bir üst kavramın doğal üyeleri olmayan somut adları birlikte verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak genel bir çekme aracı ya da yeri diye sunulamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dört somut gönderge eş adlı kullanımlar olarak ayrı ayrı korunur; görüş, amaç ve içecek tadı anlamları bu dalın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Biçim ve adlaşmış birimler ayrı göndergeler olarak verilir; bunlardan genel bir yalın araç anlamı türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı söz biçiminin adlandırdığı dört ayrı somut gönderge kümesidir: bal toplayanın kullandığı geniş kaşıksı araç, atılan ok, su çekenin üzerinde durduğu kaya ve içe doğru eğri yay.

facets.statement: Bal toplayanın yanında bulunan geniş, kaşığa benzer bir araç adlandırılır.
Atışta kullanılan ok aynı biçimle adlandırılır.
Su çeken kişinin üzerinde durduğu kaya aynı biçimle adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Bir şey değersiz, gereksiz veya geçersiz görülür ve bu nedenle dikkate alınmaz, hesaba katılmaz ya da işlemden çıkarılır.

Kan bedeli hesabında bazı deve yavruları sayıma alınmayan kalemler olarak değerlendirilir.
Bir atın koşusu ciddi ve amaçlı bir koşu değilse bu niteleme kullanılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, değersiz veya fazla görülerek dikkate alınmayan şeyi; bağlayıcı olmayan yemini; hesaptan çıkarılan kalemi; geçersiz kılma işlemini ve ciddi olmayan koşuyu aynı değerlendirme çekirdeği çevresinde toplar.

facets.statement: Belirli bir yapıda bir davranış kişiye günah sayılır veya kişi günahının karşılığıyla cezalandırılır.

Bir eylem, onu yapan kişiye günah yükü doğuracak nitelikte olabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bir davranışı günah sayma, kişiyi günaha sokma, suçlama veya cezalandırma işlemleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal günah ile kişinin bu eylemle ilişkilendirilmesi alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yanlış eylem veya kişi niteliğidir; odak dal ise bir katılımcıyı günahla ilişkilendiren geçişli işlemleri gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal cezayı verme eylemi yanında günah sayma, günaha sokma ve suçlama işlemlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal verilmiş cezanın veya günaha bağlı karşılığın kendisini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin günahının cezalandırıcı karşılığıyla ilişkilendirilmesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal karşılığı verme işlemini, komşu dal ise bu işlemin sonucu olan ceza veya karşılığı adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal günah isnadı dışında günah sayma, günaha sokma ve cezalandırma işlemlerini de taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca bir kişiyi hırsızlıkla ilişkilendirip ona bu suçu isnat etmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişiye belirli bir yanlış eylemi yükleyen suçlama yapısını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Suç isnadı bakımından yapısal olarak yakındırlar; odak dal günaha ilişkin birden çok işlemi, komşu ise yalnızca hırsızlık isnadını belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğrulanmış olsun veya olmasın günah yüklemeyi ve başka geçişli işlemleri belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuşkuya dayalı genel ithamı ve kişinin zan altında olmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir kişiye olumsuz bir eylem ya da nitelik yükleme alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın suçlama yönü özellikle günah isnadıdır; komşu dal ise içeriği daha genel olan ve kuşku durumunu öne çıkaran ithamdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğün şarap adı sayıldığı bir aktarımı korurken bu adlandırmanın tanınmış olmadığını, sağlam bir şiir tanığıyla doğrulanmadığını ve doğruluğunun belirsiz kaldığını da açıkça bildirir. Dal ancak tartışmalı ve yerleşikliği kanıtlanmamış bir adlandırma olarak tutulabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, şarabın genel adı olduğu kesinleşmiş bir anlam değil, doğruluğu ve yaygınlığı tartışmalı bir adlandırma aktarımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam çözümlenmemiştir; bu nedenle tanım yalın ve yerleşik bir anlam varsaymaz, yalnızca tartışmalı adlandırma iddiasını kaydeder.

concept_map.definition: Tartışmalı bir aktarımda sözcüğün şarap için ad olarak kullanılmasıdır. Bu adlandırmanın yerleşikliği ve aktarılan tanığın doğruluğu kesinleşmiş değildir.

facets.statement: Bazı aktarımlar sözcüğü şarap için kullanılan bir ad olarak verir.
Adlandırmanın tanınmış olmadığı, sağlam tanıkla doğrulanmadığı ve doğruluğunun belirsiz kaldığı belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu aktarım sözcüğü şarap adı olarak veren görüşü kaydeder, fakat aynı kanıt bu adın tanınmışlığını reddeden ve sağlam bir tanığa dayanmadığını belirten çekinceleri de içerir. Bu nedenle adlandırma kesin bir söz varlığı olgusu değil, doğrulanması belirsiz bir rivayet olarak anlaşılmalıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Şarap göndergesini ancak adlandırmanın doğrulanmamış ve yerleşikliği kuşkulu olduğunu belirterek sunmak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hem şarap göndergesini hem de adlandırmanın tartışmalı ve doğrulanmamış oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tartışmalı aktarımın yalnızca hangi içkiye gönderme yaptığını doğal metinde belirtmek gerektiğinde kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aktarılan adın gönderme yaptığı içkiyi doğru biçimde belirtir.
error_profile.loses: Bu adlandırmanın tanınmış olmadığı ve doğruluğunun kesinleşmediği çekincesini siler.

error_profile.preserves: Sözcüğün şaraba gönderme yaptığı yönündeki aktarımı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da şarabın adlandırılması alanında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sorunu adlandırmanın doğruluğudur ve özel bir şarap türü bildirmez; komşu dal ise şarabı saflık ve seçkinlik bakımından özelleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal şarap göndergesinde buluşur, fakat aynı tür sınırını taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal herhangi bir üretim veya tür özelliği vermez ve adlandırması kuşkuludur; komşu dal belirli bir şarap türünü niteler.
